requirements.requirement: Show PR changed files before slow review-comment pagination finishes.
evidence: pullRequestDetailProgressive.test.ts: first query excludes reviewThreads; immutable file pages publish before gated comments.
prFilesProgressive.spec.ts: Enter opens an available file before completion; subsequent pages preserve the focused DOM row.

requirements.requirement: Navigate from PR rows and exact related commits absent from the loaded graph.
evidence: pullRequestGraphJump.test.ts: fetch missing objects without changing refs, FETCH_HEAD, index, configuration or edits.
Exact older-commit navigation retains both the selected OID and the PR head.

requirements.requirement: Keep the complete dated graph and both pagination directions after jumping.
evidence: graphPrTimelineNavigation.test.ts: deleted PR refs, interleaved branches, empty/pending UI catalogs, contiguous offsets and no duplicates.
Production HTML/compiled Graph bundle: real PR controls and scroll send both newer and older requests; actual DOM equals the Native slice.

requirements.requirement: Open the correct commit history after navigation.
evidence: Real graph hash click finishes commit-detail loading; full message and parents equal independent Native Git output.

requirements.requirement: Preserve request ownership, cancellation, errors and keyboard recovery.
evidence: Stale partial responses cannot survive close/reopen or replace newer requests.
Comment failures retain files and expose a visible retry; failed exact jumps restore keyboard focus.
Existing custom filters, ref recovery, Git lifecycle and page boundaries remain covered by the regression suite.

lint.reason: eslint executable is not installed; existing repository setup was not expanded.

designChecks.resolvedFinding: Put loading/comment error status above a long file tree; keep a stable wrapper to preserve focused rows.

limitations: GitHub responses use controlled fixtures; no live GitHub network latency or universal speedup percentage was measured.
Production Graph HTML/bundle was exercised in headless Chromium with Native Git and a VS Code transport fixture, not a native Extension Host window.
The pre-existing design.json sidecar is older than DESIGN.md; it was not regenerated.
